clips.title: The story
paras: Wizbang Cranktoggle’s field research reaches Buzzbox 323, the third stop along Darkshore’s coast. You gather six Moonstalker fangs and place them in the machine north of Auberdine.

Wizbang Cranktoggle’s voice crackles through the speaker after you operate Buzzbox 411 farther south. Heavy drinking muddles his directions, but he points you north of Auberdine, to Buzzbox 323 near a road bridge. His research calls for six Moonstalker fangs from the fierce hunters roaming Darkshore’s forests.

Buzzbox 323 chatters with static and faint muttering before you begin. Place the requested fangs in its intake hopper, and the machine rattles violently, grinding the teeth into dust. Wizbang’s boozy voice returns through the transceiver to celebrate your delivery and point you toward the next machine in his scattered network.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Buzzbox gives a burst of static as you hear Wizbang begin to speak.
"The next Buzzbox is number 323. Ish north of Auberdine but... Where's the ale? Wha? Oh, ish on the road sho ya shouldn't have trouble finding it near the bridge."
Wizbang mumbles something incoherent before you hear a loud gulping sound.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Though you have yet to place the 6 Moonstalker Fangs inside, you believe you hear the sounds of static and incoherent gnome ramblings coming from within. Could someone else have fixed the machine already?

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Buzzbox suddenly leaps into action, and you can hear the distinct sounds of teeth being ground to dust coming from within.
"Sho, ya made it! Thatsh exshellent newsh... Sho... Why doncha move along? Oh! Unless you want another job!"

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
